newsitem.title: USA: Northland Cranberries cites changes for net fall.
newsitem.headline: Northland Cranberries cites changes for net fall.

text.p: Northland Cranberries Inc said Wednesday changes in the way it calculates revenues reduced its quarterly results on a comparable basis.

The company posted net income of $1.5 million in the first quarter, which ended November 30, down from $6.6 million a year ago. Revenues in the period totaled $10.9 million, compared with $21.7 million in the first quarter of fiscal 1996.

Northland President John Swendrowski said a new operating strategy that evens out distribution of the cranberries reduced the seasonal fluctuations on its balance sheet. He added the results met the company's fiscal 1997 goals.
Northland shares closed unchanged Wednesday at 22.
